rationale: C206 is a real parse-leak error. The raw SOI rows show the issuer in the first column and the investment type, reference spread or PIK terms, interest rate, maturity, par, cost, and fair value in separate columns. The flagged extracted issuer_name values concatenate those non-issuer fields into issuer_name for all four reviewed rows.
